label: D-219c46

defects.summary: Deviation 57 says S5.6.7 accepts either a non-answered row status or an OperationCanceledException, but the test only accepts the exception (`ThrowAsync<OperationCanceledException>`), so the recorded deviation is not true.

Deviations 50 and 55 still describe the skeleton ('no test was run (the fill regions throw)', MustCarryNoFlags 'is a fill region', 'spec points left open for the filler'), which is out of date for the finished change; deviation 53 also says 'the three refusals theory rows gained kimi × web', but only one row was added.

S5.6.6 tests only a plan with `Flags`; the refusal of `Leading` or `AddDirs` (the 'ANY flag' part of decision 3) has no test, and S5.6.5 does not assert the shim's `--cwd` argument, only `WorkingDirectory`.
The refused-before-the-launch arm of S5.6.7 does not check that the row's scratch is gone (rowFolder stays null); it checks only coai-vh and the recorders.
The `Scopes` helper and `StandIn()` are copied from AKimiConsultationScenarioTests into both new test classes, so the project now has three copies instead of one shared helper.
S5.6.2 gets an extra test, `TheVectorsCoverKimi`, although the plan says the existing coverage test is the scenario; also the `Records` doc comment still names only the first five runtimes and Vibe.
The new Kimi vectors' `why` text and the rows' notes use ' - ' where the rows next to them use an em dash.

summary: The planner arm (copy for disk, empty folder for none, no flags), the refusal of a plan with any flag, the three Kimi rows that cite the correct RESULTS sections and cells, the vectors, the hand-written runtimes list and the regenerated table all agree with E5.5/E5.6, and all 12 scenarios exist and pass, with the junction-first claims proved by a positive KimiHome unlink recorder. The defects are all minor: one recorded deviation that is false and some out-of-date skeleton notes in the plan, a few small gaps in the tests, and one test helper copied instead of shared.
